references.text: Psalm 131:1-3 encourages a childlike dependence and trust in the Lord, which resembles the attitude Jesus describes in Matthew 18:3.
In Matthew 19:14, Jesus again emphasizes the importance of receiving the kingdom of God like a child, reflecting the message in Matthew 18:3.
Luke 18:16-17 repeats the message about the necessity of being like children to enter the kingdom of God, parallel to Matthew 18:3.
Mark 10:15 contains a similar exhortation as in Matthew 18:3 to receive the kingdom of God like a child.
